set.body: Outcome: keep prepared evidence and identity only where execution consumes them. Acceptance: collapse method-specific Prepared shells to Unit or one internal validation token except genuinely cached evidence; remove plan/measurement/source/design identity duplicated inside method payloads when AnalysisResult already owns it; receipts retain method-specific work only; result views/tests use one authoritative identity.
set.title: P6.4b: collapse redundant prepared shells and duplicate result identity
